notes:
What's new in 0.1.138:
- Log out: the sign-in boxes are usable at once in the same window after you log out. You no longer have to restart Beebo to type a new sign-in. If the window still stays on the "Signed out" screen, the Restart Beebo button now comes back after a short wait when a restart was asked for but did not happen.
- Browser player: the volume and mute you chose are kept when the page reloads.
- Live TV: the guide and the player can now search channels and filter them by group, country and language. Refreshing keeps your chosen filters, and the new words are translated into the six shipped languages. The list can be sorted by lineup, number or name; Beebo no longer keeps a "Recently watched" or "Failed before" history for Live TV.
- Settings: the Subscription & account card now shows the Beebo email you are signed in with (or "Not signed in") and the admin username on this computer, with a link to Users. This is display only.
- Signed-in devices: a phone or TV app that signed in through the away-from-home connection is now named "Beebo phone app" or "Beebo TV app" instead of "Script".
- Pictures: posters and artwork are kept in a shared cache only for devices on your home network. Away, guest and connection-agent requests get a short private cache, and a connection Beebo cannot verify no longer gets pictures from the library.
- Parental controls: the ratings "Rated R", "18+", "R18+" and TV letters such as "TV-14 DLSV" are now read as ratings instead of unrated. An unknown preset name is refused with an error instead of silently switching all limits off. Turning a profile's limits off with the owner PIN now turns Kids Mode off too. Family viewing now compares film ratings on each country's own scale, and a second file of a film (such as a "720p" copy) is judged by the strictest rating of the same film.
- Library sharing: groundwork for changing how long a running share lasts (new end date, no end, or renewing one that ended recently). It is not on a screen yet. Changes are written to the security log and named in all six full languages.
- Story Studio: leaving the page builder right after typing now saves your last edit, saves of one story no longer overlap, "Play it" no longer crashes when a start page was just removed, a full 30-page story no longer offers a next page, and a page whose clip cannot be fetched now says so. The exported playable page's German uses the polite form (Sie).
- German: the Easy Mode message about an admin account that still has Easy Mode on now uses the polite form (Sie).
- Windows only. The phone app and Beebo Auto are separate releases.
- Automated checks: the full Windows desktop test suite was not re-run for this release. The 257 test files that cover the files changed since 0.1.137 were run: 254 passed and 3 failed because of a typing mistake in the What's new list; after it was fixed, the 36 test files that load the app screen, the sign-in screen, the What's new list and the language checks passed (36 of 36), including the 3 that had failed. The signed installer passed its signature, size, converter, connection-helper and language checks. Installed-app check on a Windows PC on Nov 23, 2026, installed from the signed installer: 1 of 1 passed (logging out, then signing in again in the same window, with no restart). Not tried yet: the in-app update from 0.1.137, the browser player keeping its volume after a reload, Live TV search and filters, the Settings account card, the parental-control and picture-cache changes, and Story Studio. The other changes in this release have not been tried by a person yet.
